[Source: creator_faq.md]
Creators can set a maximum of 3 active promotional discount codes at a time, each valid for up to 30 days.
Can a discount code last longer than a month if I want to run a special promo?

Based on what's documented here, no - 30 days is the max duration per code. A bit annoying if you're planning something longer, but you'd need to create a new code once the old one expires to keep the promo going.
